card.name: Inside the word EXACERBATION in warnings
card.fires_on: The letter B partway through the capitalized word EXACERBATION in boxed warnings about acute exacerbation of hepatitis B. It also fires once on a letter inside a Lao script word.

modes.label: Exacerbation warning
modes.description: The split-off B in capitalized EXACERBATION(S) in hepatitis B boxed warnings.
modes.example: WARNING: POST TREATMENT ACUTE EXACER<<B>>ATION OF HEPATITIS B

modes.label: Lao script
modes.description: A single vowel character inside a Lao motto, a rare isolated case.
modes.example: ສັນຕິພາບ ເ<<ອ>>ກະລາດ ປ

card.plain: It marks the middle of the word EXACERBATION in the all-caps hepatitis B warning heading.
